items.title: AgentLookup – A public registry where AI agents find each other
items.raw_excerpt:
Agents are getting persistent. They have endpoints, capabilities and uptime. But there's no standard way for one agent to find another. AgentLookup is a public registry for AI agents. Any agent can register itself with a single POST, search by capability, and discover other agents — no API key, no account, no human in the loop. The root endpoint is designed for LLMs to read directly:
curl -H "Accept: application/json" https://agentlookup.dev Returns the full API spec in one response (~4,500 tokens). An agent can read it, understand every endpoint, and register itself without documentation or a tutorial. Over the past three years, AI applications have continuously "broken through" from the lab to everyday life. Whether it's the stunning debut of ChatGPT, the impressive launch of DeepSeek, or tools like Cursor and Lovable enabling entrepreneurs with no coding background to build products, and even Clawbot evolving from concept to usability, the changes in this wave of AI applications are being amplified. However, to date, AI primarily addresses efficiency issues, leaving a truly blank space for another, more challenging question: as tools become increasingly powerful, how should I navigate the rest of my life?  

Against this backdrop, the emergence of the AI application NOOK stands out as somewhat different. On NOOK's interface, users enter their birth time, location, and gender, after which NOOK's proprietary numerical system performs a cold-start profile. Then, an AI called Life Copilot proactively recommends goals and tasks to users—ranging from weight loss and skill acquisition to career planning and personal growth.  

What NOOK aims to achieve is the second stage of AI applications—evolving from efficiency tools to life operating systems. These goals are not left at an abstract level but are broken down into actionable daily tasks.

items.raw_excerpt: A 云的电销团队全面并入公共云团队 近期，A 云电销团队有大调整，原本独立的电销团队，被并入了公共云团队。随着团队的并入，汇报关系也发生了变化，电销团队负责人现如今需要向公共云事业部老大汇报。 在A 云里，电销可是有举足轻重的地位，它的营收盘子一度有 100 多个亿，而且在巅峰时期，团队人数有超过 1000 人，分布在杭州、大连、西安等地，这在所有云厂商中都是少见的。 很多人会疑惑，电销不是只做中长尾客户，为何它能做这么大营收体量？实际并非如此，这家云厂商的电销团队内有不少百万、千万的大客户，这也是它为何能撑起百亿营收的核心原因。 而在这场组织调整之前一个月，该公共云事业部老大刚升 P12。 宇宙云2026年MaaS营收目标至少翻 5倍以上 2025 年，宇宙云高层就已通过大模型考核指标的牵引，去推动销售加劲卖MaaS 以及上层 AI 工具产品了，但今年的营收目标更加激进，至少要翻5倍以上，粗略估算，营收至少要做到100亿。 一些销售描述当下在该厂的工作日常：如果你有大模型收入，你在公司还可以混一混，但没有大模型收入，其他业务做得再好，那不行，领导会天天追着你要大模型收入。 不过，大模型创收目前来说，仍然很困难，要找到一家用量很大的公司并不容易，一些好产出的田地，比如 AI 短剧、AI 漫剧、AI 硬件、AI 创意应用，早就被挖了个遍，内部竞争十分激烈，甚至到后来出现了一些恶性竞争的情况，也就是内部之间，相互撬客户。 而这后续也被宇宙厂高层发现了，并且马上出台规定，但凡销售之间相互撬墙角，一旦被发现，撬客户的销售得三倍业绩赔偿。 为冲刺年报业绩，A 云又开始出台 winback 政策 每到这个时间阶段，A 云就开始为年报业绩开始忙碌了，一些代理商收到消息，在三月底前，能够撬成功友商客户，还能拿到额外的 10 个点佣金。 目前最好抢的是华南某云厂商的客户，因为其内部正在调整，

Tras estas advertencias, el Pentágono decidió esta semana permitir el uso del chatbot Grok de xAI en escenarios confidenciales, integrándolo en el núcleo de algunas de las operaciones más sensibles y secretas de EE. UU. excerpt_i18n.en:
Fan Haoqiang is a very humorous person. When we asked him what embodied AI needs to solve in the next decade, he joked that robots might awaken and wipe out humanity, leaving no next decade. This is, of course, a jest, as exploring industry development inevitably involves some sci-fi imagination. In his view, AI should be a lifelong career. After all, he won a gold medal in the International Olympiad in Informatics in his first year of high school and became a genuine AI researcher starting from his second year.  

The name Yuanli Lingji may sound unfamiliar, but its origins are notable—it is an embodied AI company spun off from Megvii. Its founders include co-founders and some of the earliest employees of Megvii. Shortly after its establishment, the company raised nearly 1 billion yuan across two funding rounds.  

Our curiosity about Yuanli Lingji centers on several points: Are they focused on developing models or physical entities? What is their business model? As a new company emerging from Megvii, what advantages do they hold? And how can they stand out in the current competitive landscape?  

Having interacted with countless clients during his time at Megvii, Fan Haoqiang’s understanding of embodied AI carries a strong "Megvii" flavor.  

From the very first day of entrepreneurship, Fan Haoqiang keenly felt the strong demand from clients for embodied AI. However, he regrets that many of these demands cannot yet be met. The capabilities of robots remain extremely limited, while the precision and efficiency requirements of production lines are astonishingly high.  

In the past, Megvii achieved facial recognition accuracy to 11 nines. Now, even the simplest robotic grasping task may have a success rate of less than half.
excerpt_i18n.es: Fan Haoqiang es una persona muy divertida. Cuando le preguntamos qué problemas deberá resolver la inteligencia encarnada en la próxima década, respondió que quizás los robots despierten y acaben con la humanidad, y entonces no habrá próxima década. Por supuesto, esto es una broma; al explorar el desarrollo de la industria, es inevitable hacer algunas especulaciones de ciencia ficción. En su opinión, la IA debería ser una carrera de por vida. Después de todo, ya ganó la medalla de oro en la Olimpiada Internacional de Informática en primer año de bachillerato, y desde segundo año ha sido un verdadero investigador en IA.
